description: A custom Android ViewGroup layout named FixedGridLayout that arranges its child views in a grid with fixed cell sizes specified via XML attributes or programmatically. The layout dynamically calculates the number of columns and positions each child within the grid.

classes.name: FixedGridLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that arranges its children in a grid with fixed cell size and dynamically determines the number of columns based on its measured width.

methods.name: FixedGridLayout
methods.description: Constructs the FixedGridLayout with specified context and optional attribute set.

methods.name: setCellWidth
methods.description: Sets the cell width in pixels and requests a layout pass.

methods.name: setCellHeight
methods.description: Sets the cell height in pixels and requests a layout pass.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the layout and its children based on the fixed cell sizes and the number of children.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views within the grid, centering each child within its cell.
